records.question: How many distinct products were sold in 2010?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) AS distinct_products FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2010 LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the total quantity of items sold in Germany?
records.agent_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM sales WHERE country = 'Germany' LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers are there in France?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM sales WHERE country = 'France' AND NOT customer_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many products were sold in both the United Kingdom and Germany?
records.agent_sql: WITH per_product AS (SELECT stock_code FROM sales WHERE country IN ('United Kingdom', 'Germany') GROUP BY stock_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT country) = 2) SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM per_product LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers have spent more than 5000 in total?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_spent FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(revenue) > 5000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer_spending LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many products have been bought by more than 100 different customers?
records.agent_sql: WITH product_customers AS (SELECT stock_code FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY stock_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) > 100) SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_count FROM product_customers LIMIT 1000

records.question: whats the total rev for 2011
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2011 LIMIT 1000

records.question: top 3 countrys by number of invoices
records.agent_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS invoice_count FROM sales GROUP BY country ORDER BY invoice_count DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: how many cancelld orders did customer 14646 hav
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS cancelled_orders FROM cancellations WHERE customer_id = 14646 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which month in 2010 had the lowest revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT STRFTIME(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2010 GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_revenue ASC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the average number of units per invoice?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(invoice_total_quantity), 2) AS avg_units_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice, SUM(quantity) AS invoice_total_quantity FROM sales GROUP BY invoice) AS t LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many invoices contain more than 20 line items?
records.agent_sql: WITH invoice_line_counts AS (SELECT invoice, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM sales GROUP BY invoice HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices_count FROM invoice_line_counts LIMIT 1000
